description:
ADVENTURE AWAITS ON EVERY RIDE!
The 24-inch Chameleon is built for kids to explore the outdoors and join you on longer rides. Its 250W hub motor provides throttle power when needed, while the strong battery ensures your child keeps pace on the trails. Designed to handle tough terrain, this e-bike features durable aluminum wheels and a disc brake with motor cut-off for added safety. Sturdy and reliable, it’s made to provide years of adventure. Adjustable power levels give parents peace of mind and allow kids to gradually gain confidence and control. This setup also lets parents manage speed and power based on their child’s age and experience level, ensuring a safer riding experience *Recommended for ages 9-12 years old.*Weight Limit: 180lbs

components.description: Front and Rear Cable Brake with Built-in Safety Electric Motor Cut-off; 180mm Cable Brakes with safety motor cut off

With an integrated battery into the frame, we're able to provide a larger capacity then other Kid's ebikes at 24v 10.5aH. It's protected from crashes, falls, and the elements. With an average range of up to 15 miles, you're kids are ready for endless fun!

The Chameleon has a 250w motor that has a top speed of around 17mph. Fast enough to give the kids a thrill but slow enough to keep them under control. The Mechanical disk brakes include an activated motor cutoff for quick and easy stopping.

Just like a dirt bike, the Rambo Kid's ebikes delivers throttle-controlled power on demand. With the 20" x 1.95" tires and throttle-controlled power, the Chameleon is designed for years of entertainment.; Twist Throttle with 3 adjustable power settings
24" x 1.95"with Aggressive Tread ready to take on any adventure
